about.title: About this library
about.body:
# Hi, welcome to jon's books.

This is a structural library, organized as a framework for understanding the world and oneself.

I've been collecting books, mostly on e-reader for a few years. Unlike having a physical bookshelf, I find it difficult to have an overview of what books I own. I created this web app as an easy way to look at what books I have, and most importantly, understand what I like, how I look at things, and even explore different modes of being. 

A lot of people have made a virtual bookshelf, the first one I came across might be [this](https://www.katrinatantay.com/library/) then [this](https://thevisibleshelf.com/). We all have totally different approaches, and building this is part of the fun. 

Here's a quote regarding the pressure to read all(?) the books you have:
>“Think not of the books you’ve bought as a ‘to be read’ pile. Instead, think of your bookcase as a wine cellar. You collect books to be read at the right time, the right place, and the right mood.” ― Luc van Donkersgoed

Yes, very liberating. 
Browse around. May you get inspired, discover the next book here or elsewhere, and find out what version of you awaits.

---
## Use this for your books
You can download to run it locally or publish it online. More info [here](https://github.com/jonnlo/jons-books)
